name: windows-guard
description: Stops GitHub Copilot CLI from corrupting files on Windows. Restores line endings and strips BOMs after every edit, blocks bash-isms, unsafe shell writes and silent wrong-directory commands in PowerShell, refuses edits that would destroy non-UTF-8 files, and coaches the model through quoting, edit-match and environment failures instead of letting it rewrite whole files. Ships an optional in-process extension engine.
